intent: A focused passkey sign-in card where a hand-drawn fingerprint is the interface: it draws in, a scan line reads it while the device answers, and success fills it with light from the core outward. The card rises out of a blur and its contents stagger in reading order before the print draws.

stack.icons: none: every glyph is hand-drawn SVG

layout.card: max-width 400px, #0b0b0c, 1px white/8% border, radius 28px, inset top highlight, padding 40/36/28px (32/24/24px under 360px container), centred stack
layout.glyph: 164px well (148px small) with 7% hairline and inner shadow; 130px svg in a 120 viewBox clipped to r=47
layout.actions: 48px primary button radius 14px full width; 44px secondary row for Cancel / Use email instead

color.approach: monochrome; one accent prop (default = theme ink) on the primary button; mint only for success, rose/red only for error; tokens in one PALETTE → --pk-* CSS variables
color.button: accent fill, black-or-white label; it keeps the accent on success and draws a check

motion.entrance: once at 30% in view: card y 16→0 + blur 10→0 over 600ms; then brand → heading → description → glyph well → status → button → link, 50ms apart from 120ms (opacity, 10px rise, 6px blur clearing, 450ms); ridges pathLength 0→1 over 700ms once the glyph block lands, each delayed by 400ms × normalised distance from the core
motion.awaiting: 34-unit gradient band masks a bright ridge layer and a 1px scan line in ink; travels top → bottom → top in 2.6s ease-in-out, looping (the one ambient signal); the status copy carries a static ellipsis
motion.success: radial mask r 0→90 over 850ms lights mint ridges from the core outward while a 1px mint ring draws round the well (pathLength, 700ms); badge springs in at 550ms (500/28) and its check draws over 360ms; button stays accent with a drawn check
motion.cancel: glyph settles scale 1 → .97 → 1 over 600ms, ridges dim (CSS stroke transition between tokens)
motion.swaps: copy and labels cross-fade with 6–8px offset and 3–4px blur, 220ms in, 120ms out
motion.cleanup: usePasskeyCeremony owns one AbortController per attempt; the timeout and the success hold go through useTimeouts and are cleared on unmount, which also aborts the ceremony
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades only; no drawing; band parked at centre

responsive.narrow: under a 360px container: tighter padding, 148px well
responsive.wide: card caps at 400px, centred on the stage

accessibility: svg role=img with a state-aware label
Cancel returns focus to the primary button

content.title: Welcome back
content.description: Sign in with the passkey saved on this device. Nothing to type, nothing to remember.
content.states: idle, awaiting, success, cancelled, timeout, unsupported, error
content.api: onAuthenticate(signal) => Promise; NotAllowedError/AbortError = cancel; timeoutMs aborts

avoid: a page or marketing copy around the card
a glow bloom behind the well
